heading.en: 230 V, but the peak is 325 V

hook.en: The mains is called 230 V, yet the voltage actually swings up to about 325 V and down to −325 V. Which number is "the" voltage? It depends on what you want to measure.
hook.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸರಬರಾಜನ್ನು 230 V ಎನ್ನುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಆದರೆ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ಸುಮಾರು 325 V ವರೆಗೆ ಏರಿ −325 V ವರೆಗೆ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಾವ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಸರಿ? ಅದು ನಾವು ಏನನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆ.

title.en: Define peak, peak-to-peak, average and RMS values
Calculate form factor and peak factor
Convert between them for a sine wave

say.en: The mains is called 230 volts, yet the voltage actually swings up to about 325 volts and down to minus 325 volts. Which number is "the" voltage? It depends on what you want to measure. In this lesson: Define peak, peak-to-peak, average and RMS values.
Calculate form factor and peak factor.
Convert between them for a sine wave.

body.en: The peak value $V_m$ is the largest value in a cycle and the peak-to-peak value is $2V_m$. Over a full cycle a sine wave *averages* to zero, so the average value is taken over a half cycle: $V_{av} = 2V_m/π = 0.637 V_m$.
body.kn: ಶಿಖರ ಮೌಲ್ಯ Vm ಆವರ್ತದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಮೌಲ್ಯ; ಶಿಖರದಿಂದ ಶಿಖರಕ್ಕೆ 2Vm. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆವರ್ತದ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅರ್ಧ ಆವರ್ತದ ಸರಾಸರಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೇವೆ: Vav = 0.637 Vm.

say.en: Full-cycle average equals 0.
Half-cycle average equals 0.637 V m.

title.en: On the board: Peak, average and RMS

say.en: Take one cycle of a sine wave with peak Vm. Over the whole cycle the average is zero, so we look at a half cycle.
The average over a half cycle is 2Vm over pi, about 0.637 Vm.
The RMS value, which gives the same heat as DC, is Vm over root 2, about 0.707 Vm. It is a little above the average.
Our meters show 230 volts RMS. So the peak is 230 times 1.414, that is 325 volts, and the average is 207 volts.
Two shape factors: form factor is RMS over average, 1.11; peak factor is peak over RMS, 1.414.
On the board: Peak, average and RMS.

body.en: The RMS (root mean square) or effective value is the steady DC that would produce the same heat in a resistor. For a sine wave $V_{rms} = V_m/\sqrt{2} = 0.707 V_m$. AC voltmeters and ammeters read *RMS values*, so 230 V mains has $V_m = 230 × 1.414 ≈ 325 V$.
body.kn: RMS ಅಥವಾ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಎಂದರೆ ರೋಧಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ಉಷ್ಣ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುವ ಸ್ಥಿರ DC. ಸೈನ್ ತರಂಗಕ್ಕೆ Vrms = 0.707 Vm. AC ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗಳು RMS ಮೌಲ್ಯ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: *Form factor* = RMS value ÷ average value = 1.11 for a sine wave. Peak (crest) factor = peak value ÷ RMS value = 1.414 for a sine wave. These factors describe the shape of a waveform; a square wave has both equal to 1.
body.kn: ರೂಪ ಅಂಶ = RMS ÷ ಸರಾಸರಿ = 1.11; ಶಿಖರ ಅಂಶ = ಶಿಖರ ÷ RMS = 1.414 (ಸೈನ್ ತರಂಗಕ್ಕೆ). ಚೌಕ ತರಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡೂ 1.

problem.en: The mains is 230 V RMS. Find the peak, peak-to-peak and half-cycle average values.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The mains is 230 V RMS. Find the peak, peak-to-peak and half-cycle average values.

say.en: Let us solve this together. The mains is 230 volts RMS. Find the peak, peak-to-peak and half-cycle average values.
V m equals the square root of 2 times 230 equals 1.414 times 230 equals 325.3 volts.
V pp equals 2 times 325.3 equals 650.5 volts.
V av equals 0.637 times 325.3 equals 207.1 volts.
So the answer is 325 volts, 651 volts, 207 volts.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A current i equals 14.14 sin omega t A flows through a 10 ohms resistor. Find the RMS current and the power.
I rms equals 14.14/ the square root of 2 equals 10 A.
P equals I rms squared R equals 100 times 10 equals 1000 watts.
So the answer is 10 A; 1 kilowatt.
